verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an in-product agent (@agent), no-code Agent Flows, and code-based custom agent skills, but nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to run shell commands or edit local files. Custom skills and MCP compatibility are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here. The axis applies to a local AI assistant, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can run commands and edit files on my machine — a real exec surface, not just chat about what to do
